EmailTemplate.description: Notification that user has been added to a site.
EmailTemplate.name: NZC Experience Cloud New Member Welcome Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to {!Community_Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Receiving_User.Name},
Cognizant has set a goal of achieving Net Zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Over 75% of Cognizant’s emissions are generated through its sourcing of goods and services. Consequently, we are prioritizing the need for suppliers to set emission reduction targets, provide data and keep Cognizant updated on their progress.
Cognizant is using Net Zero Cloud to manage its engagement with suppliers on emissions reduction. We have created your company with a dedicated profile on Net Zero Cloud, which you can use to provide emissions data and other key sustainability information.
To get started, go to {!Community_Url} and log in with your username {!Receiving_User.Username}
Cognizant requires {!Receiving_User.Name} to update this profile annually. This is crucial to enable us to calculate and reduce emissions. We therefore strongly encourage you to provide this information promptly.
Thanks, Net Zero Team
